title: Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act 1940

sections.shortTitle: Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act 1940
sections.description:
Short title

The Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940
The Offences on
Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940
Received the assent of the Governor General on the
23rd February, 1940, and is published in the Gazette of India, dated the 2nd
March 1940.
Act No. IV of
1940.
An Act to extend the operation of
the criminal law to offences committed on ships or aircraft registered in
British India wherever they may be.
1. Short title.-This Act
may be called the Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940.
Notes.
Object.-"The Indian Aircraft (Amendment) Act, 1939 (XXXVII of 1939),
was enacted to enforce compliance with certain regulations, framed to meet
India's extra-territorial obligations arising out of the International
Convention of 1939, by all aircraft registered in India, wherever they may
happen to be. In order to make these regulations effective it has been found
accessory to amend section 4 of the Indian Penal Code and section 188 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898. As the law now stands, offences committed (a)
outside British India by foreigners and (b) by British subjects other than
Indian British subjects outside India on aircraft registered in British India
cannot be dealt with in British Indian Courts. It is therefore now proposed to
amend the criminal law so as to extend its operation to offences committed by
such persons on aircraft registered in British. India wherever it may be. It is
also proposed to take advantage of this opportunity to make a similar amendment
in the law in so far as offences on ships registered in India are concerned'
[Vide Statement of Objects and Reasons printed at page 79 of Part V of the
Gazette of India, dated the 10th February 1940].

The Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940
The Offences on
Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940
Received the assent of the Governor General on the
23rd February, 1940, and is published in the Gazette of India, dated the 2nd
March 1940.
Act No. IV of
1940.
An Act to extend the operation of
the criminal law to offences committed on ships or aircraft registered in
British India wherever they may be.
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Act XLV of 1860.--In section 4 of the Indian Penal Code, after clause (3)
the following clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(4) any
person on any ship or aircraft registered in British India wherever it may
be." . .
